title: Fast seed selection for the term-major pruned scorer
question: Does a faster seed selection make the term-major pruned scorer faster, with the same seeds, schedule and answers?
hypothesis: Yes at both range sizes, more at 256, from the profiled 22-48 us select_seeds kernel; the gain is bounded by that time.
motivation: Profile-driven: select_seeds is the largest remaining pruning overhead, one thread block stalled on barriers and uncoalesced loads.
correctness_rule: Every configuration's top-10 equals the CPU reference for every query; prunets' schedule equals the host recomputation (VERIFY=1) and prunetb's.
success_rule: A complete run under the registered protocol; reported whatever the ratios are.
failure_rule: Any mismatch or rejected expected run; ineligible processes are replaced.
